## Getting help

1. Read the README + smoke checklist
2. Search [Issues](https://github.com/nickotmazgin/fluentvoice-pro/issues)
3. Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/nickotmazgin/fluentvoice-pro/discussions)

**Bugs / features:** use Issue templates (not Discussions for confirmed bugs).

## When reporting bugs

Include:

- Windows 11/10 build
- FluentVoice version (e.g. 1.4.3)
- Source ZIP vs portable EXE
- Voice used (neural vs offline)
- Steps to reproduce (do **not** paste private clipboard text)
